# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repo root: it holds this project's hard rules
(no Robux; never press Enter/E/Yes on a guess; never click Roblox "I Agree";
new movement ships look-only first; optional features default off; no
secrets or `var/` in the repo; GPL-3.0), how to run and test it, the code
map, and how code here is written (evidence comments, small shared fixes).
